The Royal Bengal Tiger is the national animal of India, renowned for its strength, grace, and agility. In 1973, India launched 'Project Tiger' to establish dedicated tiger reserves and protect these majestic big cats from extinction. Today, India is home to over 70% of the world's wild tiger population, thriving across protected national parks and sanctuaries.
